description:
🌌 Dynamic Asteroids
Breathes dynamic life into static asteroid belts!

Game Version: Starsector 0.98a-RC8 (Supports 0.97a)
Compatibility: Java 8 (Works seamlessly on vanilla and custom JREs)
Mod Author & Contact (Discord): keltuze

📦 DOWNLOADS & SOURCE
🔗 GitHub Repository & Releases
📦 Alternative Mirror (Gofile)

🚀 About the Mod
For years, I wanted active, moving asteroid fields in Starsector. In the vanilla game, asteroids are completely static, sitting there as lifeless environmental obstacles. I created this mod from scratch to turn them into active, rushing rivers of cosmic debris during combat!

Because of how the sequential spawning works, the rocks naturally group up into rolling waves as they fly across the battlefield, creating a surprisingly cool and cinematic backdrop for your space battles.

⚙️ How It Works (Exact Mechanics)

Vanilla Cleanup: Static vanilla asteroids are automatically cleared at combat start so they don't sit motionless.
Velocity Lock: Asteroids continuously fly across the battlefield at a fixed 600 u/s (the upper safe speed limit of Starsector's physics engine before collision tunneling occurs). The plugin dynamically resets their speed back to 600 u/s if they bump into each other, preventing traffic jams.
Dynamic Direction: At the start of each battle, 1 of 4 cardinal directions is rolled for the entire fight (Left to Right, Right to Left, Bottom to Top, or Top to Bottom).
Density Variety: The asteroid count is rolled once per battle between 70 and 160 rocks and maintained at that density until combat ends.
30-Second Lifespan: Each spawned rock lives for exactly 30 seconds before safely dissolving into space dust.
Flagship HUD UI: A status indicator in the bottom-left of your screen displays the active flow direction and the exact number of rocks currently on the field.

💻 Performance & Settings Configuration
If hosting up to 160 active rocks causes FPS drops on your setup, you can easily adjust the density limits on the fly in-game via LunaLib (F2).

Alternatively, you can manually edit the config file at:
mods/DynamicAsteroids/data/config/dynamic_asteroids_settings.json
(Tweak the minFieldRocks and maxFieldRocks values to fit your performance needs).

P.S. Looking for extra chaos? Try the Extreme version profiles where the collision impact of each asteroid is heavily multiplied, shoving and spinning ships across the map!

AI Use & Development Disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools.
Code Architecture: Written entirely via AI prompts.
Human Involvement (Creative Director & Editor):
Checked, refined, compiled, and edited all generated code.
Identified performance bugs and fixed collision scaling issues.
Assessed campaign save-game compatibility to ensure stability.
Managed extensive functional iterations and executed a clean, lightweight codebase rewrite from scratch.

discordPostHtml:
Breathes life into static asteroid belts!
In vanilla Starsector, asteroids just hang motionless in space. Dynamic Asteroids turns them into active, rushing rivers of space debris during combat.

Terrain Detection: Uses the campaign world map to strictly check if your fleet is inside an asteroid belt, field, or planetary ring (ASTEROID_BELT, ASTEROID_FIELD, RING).
Asteroid Fields / Belts:
Continuous Stream: Asteroids rush across the map along 1 of 4 cardinal directions (Left, Right, Up, Down — rolled 25% each at battle start).
Density: 70 to 160 rocks rolled once per combat. (new update 100-1000)
HUD Hazard Alert: The flagship's HUD displays the current drift direction and active field rock count.
Deep Space / Open Space (Outside Asteroid Belts):
Sparse Meteors: Only 4 to 10 stray rocks in the entire sector.
Irregular Spacing: Spawns with a randomized delay between 1.5s and 5.0s, ensuring rocks drift by sporadically one by one rather than forming a solid wave.
Quiet HUD: Shows calm situational info without emergency alarms.
Refit Simulator: Always models a full asteroid storm so you can stress-test ship shields and point defense.
Anti-Brake Cruise Control: Prevents physics engine collision dampening from stalling the rocks — asteroids actively maintain speed after impacts.
30-Second Lifespan: Asteroids expire gracefully with a soft dust puff after 30 seconds, preventing sector clutter and preserving FPS.
Mid-Campaign Safe: 100% safe to add or remove at any point in an ongoing campaign (pure combat engine plugin, writes zero data to save files).

Stress Test https://youtu.be/mda3KVTvqBE more asteroid!
https://github.com/keltuze/DynamicAsteroids#-how-it-works

p.s I hereby grant the game developers full, unrestricted rights to use, modify, and integrate the concepts, assets, and code from this mod into the official game. I would be absolutely thrilled to see these "crazy asteroids" become a native part of the universe.
